{{Quote|Clan Eldar is with you.|This leader, to Bo-Katan Kryze|<ref name="Heroes" />}}
A '''Mandalorian''' of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Clan Eldar]] pledged his [[Mandalorian clan|clan]] to [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the [[Mandalorian resistance]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] along with several other Mandalorian factions following the [[Mission to Mandalore]] during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|Mandalorian Civil War]]. The Mandalorian leader's support, along with the other Mandalorians, allowed Bo-Katan to take the mantle of [[Mandalore (title)|Mand'alor]].<ref name="Heroes" />

The Mandalorian had dark skin and a [[Color|black]] mustache and beard. He wore [[Mandalorian armor]] that was primarily gray with orange markings.<ref name="Heroes" />
